children: Calviks AB signed a binding deal to buy 70% of Drift Sør at an EV of ~NOK 107.5M. Drift Sør expects ~NOK 270M 2026 revenue and ~NOK 21M EBIT. Closing is subject to financing and customary conditions.
Adds scale in Norwegian energy/industrial staffing; expands segment exposure.
Implied valuation benchmark; helps gauge deal multiples vs EBIT.
Signals revenue uplift potential if the deal closes.
Cash outlay requires financing; affects leverage/liquidity.
Deal risk remains; timing and terms of funding are key catalysts.

This extends Calviks’ Norway build-out after Subshore, reinforcing a strategy of M&A-led growth in energy and industry staffing. A secured financing package and confirmed closing, plus post-close performance vs earn-out targets, would make this a larger catalyst.
